morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词借用，无马来语词缀；/ŋ/ 后接 /k/，词尾为 /əl/。所列为英语参考音，马来西亚实际读音有变体。

senses.zh_definition: 叔伯、舅父、姑父或姨父；英语亲属称谓，不细分父系、母系或长幼。
senses.en_definition: A brother of one's parent, or the husband of one's aunt.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, saudara lelaki kepada ibu atau bapa, atau suami kepada ibu saudara; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah bapa saudara atau pak cik.
senses.nuances: 此处是英语词在马来语交谈中的使用，不应理解为已获认定的标准马来语词。正式马来语通常用 bapa saudara；不能仅凭 uncle 判断具体是哪一种中文亲属关系。释义依据：[Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=uncle)。

collocations.zh: 我的叔伯／舅父等男性长辈亲属
母亲那边的叔舅辈亲属
collocations.en: an uncle on my mother's side

senses.zh_definition: 对父辈或较年长男子的熟络称呼，相当于“叔叔”，不一定有亲属关系。
senses.en_definition: A familiar form of address or reference for an older man, including someone unrelated to the speaker.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam percakapan tidak rasmi, panggilan mesra kepada lelaki yang lebih tua atau kenalan lelaki keluarga, walaupun tiada hubungan kekeluargaan.
senses.nuances: 常见于马来西亚多语日常交流；亲近程度和年龄判断会影响是否合适。不能据此推断对方的族群。DBP 收录的英语义项也包括非亲属的家庭男性朋友：[PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=uncle)。

collocations.en: the older man at the coffee shop

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻报道中的口语称谓引述
dual_scenarios.ms: Penduduk mengenali penjaga kedai itu dengan panggilan mesra “uncle”.
dual_scenarios.zh: 居民们都亲切地称那位看店男子为“叔叔”。
dual_scenarios.en: Residents know the man who looks after the shop by the affectionate name “uncle”.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Uncle, saya nak dua bungkus nasi lemak je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Pak cik, saya mahu dua bungkus nasi lemak sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 叔叔，我要两包椰浆饭就好。
dual_scenarios.en: Uncle, just two packets of nasi lemak, please.
spoken_features: uncle 用作熟络的非亲属称呼
nak 对应 mahu
je 对应 sahaja

messages.speaker: Mei (顾客)
messages.ms_spoken: Uncle, nasi lemak dah siap ke? Saya nak dua bungkus je.
messages.ms_standard: Pak cik, adakah nasi lemak sudah siap? Saya mahu dua bungkus sahaja.
messages.zh: 叔叔，椰浆饭好了吗？我要两包就好。
messages.en: Uncle, is the nasi lemak ready? I'd like just two packets.

messages.speaker: Lim (摊主)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah siap. Nak sambal lebih tak?
messages.ms_standard: Sudah siap. Adakah kamu mahu sambal tambahan?
messages.zh: 好了。要多加一点参巴吗？
messages.en: It's ready. Would you like extra sambal?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 日常称呼年长男子时可显亲切，但对年龄相近者可能显得把人叫老了；职场初次见面优先使用姓名、职衔或 Encik。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于熟悉的邻居、摊主和家庭朋友；正式公文叙述亲属关系时用 bapa saudara。作为姓名前的称呼时通常写 Uncle Lim。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 日常称呼年长男子时可显亲切，但对年龄相近者可能显得把人叫老了；职场初次见面优先使用姓名、职衔或 Encik。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于熟悉的邻居、摊主和家庭朋友；正式公文叙述亲属关系时用 bapa saudara。作为姓名前的称呼时通常写 Uncle Lim。

etymology.historical_story: English uncle passed through Anglo-French into Middle English from Latin avunculus, which referred to a mother's brother. Its family meaning later became broader. In Malaysian multilingual conversation, it also serves as a familiar address for older men, so an uncle need not be a relative. Sources: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/uncle), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=uncle).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /ˈʌŋ.kəl/ 和熟悉的“安哥／uncle”称呼连起来：像叔叔一样称呼，未必真是亲戚。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根本身不发生音变；接 meN- 时，元音前使用 meng-，形成 mengugut。

senses.zh_definition: 以伤害或其他不利后果恐吓他人，使其服从或按要求行事。
senses.en_definition: To threaten someone with harm or adverse consequences to make them comply.
senses.ms_definition: Menakutkan seseorang dengan ancaman supaya orang itu melakukan sesuatu atau menurut kehendak pihak yang mengancam.
senses.nuances: 通常带有强制和负面意味，区别于善意提醒。正式主动陈述句通常用 mengugut；词根 ugut 常用于命令、禁止句及口语。peras ugut 是固定搭配，专指通过威胁勒索财物或利益。词义依据：[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=ugut)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengerusi menegaskan: Jangan ugut pekerja supaya mereka menarik balik aduan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 主席强调：不得恐吓员工，迫使他们撤回投诉。
dual_scenarios.en: The chairperson stressed: Do not threaten employees into withdrawing their complaints.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jangan ugut aku macam tu lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jangan mengugut saya seperti itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 别这样吓唬我啦。
dual_scenarios.en: Don't threaten me like that.
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式。
macam tu 对应标准语 seperti itu。
lah 在这里加强抗议语气，不表示客气。
aku 适用于熟人之间，也可能显得强硬。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dia ugut kau lagi ke kat WhatsApp?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah dia mengugut kamu lagi melalui WhatsApp?
messages.zh: 他又在 WhatsApp 上威胁你了？
messages.en: Is he threatening you on WhatsApp again?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, aku dah simpan semua mesej tu.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah menyimpan semua mesej itu.
messages.zh: 对，那些消息我都保存好了。
messages.en: Yes, I've saved all those messages.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说对方 mengugut 是较严厉的指控；表达不满时应说明具体言语或行为。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式汇报可用 mengugut 描述行为，用 ugutan 指威胁内容。不要把普通劝告或合理提醒随意称为 ugut。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说对方 mengugut 是较严厉的指控；表达不满时应说明具体言语或行为。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式汇报可用 mengugut 描述行为，用 ugutan 指威胁内容。不要把普通劝告或合理提醒随意称为 ugut。

etymology.historical_story: ugut 在马来语中作为表示恐吓的基本词根使用，现有词包未提供可确认的更早来源。围绕这一词根，mengugut 表示实施恐吓，ugutan 指恐吓内容，pengugut 则指实施者，形成了完整的行为词族。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人用一句威胁逼你退后：动作是 mengugut，那句话是 ugutan，说话的人是 pengugut。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成表示测量结果或尺寸的名词；词根拼写不变，末尾 r 在派生词中成为下一音节的声母。

senses.zh_definition: 测量所得的尺寸或大小，如长度、宽度、高度或围度。
senses.en_definition: The size or dimensions of something, as established by measurement.
senses.ms_definition: Besarnya sesuatu, seperti panjang, lebar, tinggi atau lilitnya, yang diketahui melalui pengukuran.
senses.nuances: 本义强调测得的尺寸，可用于衣服、家具、建筑等。与 saiz 相比，ukuran 更容易使人联想到具体测量数据；报告数值时宜注明单位。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kontraktor diminta mengesahkan ukuran bilik sebelum kerja pemasangan kabinet dimulakan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 承包商须在橱柜安装工程开始前确认房间尺寸。
dual_scenarios.en: The contractor is asked to confirm the room dimensions before cabinet installation begins.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dah ambil ukuran tingkap tu? Aku nak tempah langsir.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sudahkah kamu mengambil ukuran tingkap itu? Saya hendak menempah langsir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个窗户的尺寸量好了吗？我想订做窗帘。
dual_scenarios.en: Have you measured that window yet? I want to order curtains.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式
tu 对应 itu，nak 对应 hendak
aku 适用于熟人之间；正式交流宜用 saya

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah ambil ukuran tingkap tu? Aku nak tempah langsir.
messages.ms_standard: Sudahkah kamu mengambil ukuran tingkap itu? Saya hendak menempah langsir.
messages.zh: 那个窗户的尺寸量好了吗？我想订做窗帘。
messages.en: Have you measured that window yet? I want to order curtains.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, aku dah tulis ukuran dia kat kertas ni. Nanti aku hantar gambar.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, saya telah mencatat ukuran tingkap itu pada kertas ini. Saya akan menghantar gambarnya nanti.

messages.en: Yes, I've written the measurements on this sheet. I'll send you a photo in a bit.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向裁缝或服务人员询问尺寸时，可用 Boleh saya tahu ukuran yang diperlukan?，语气自然礼貌。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 量体或询问他人身体尺寸前先说明用途并征得同意；交换尺寸时注明厘米、米等单位，避免误解。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向裁缝或服务人员询问尺寸时，可用 Boleh saya tahu ukuran yang diperlukan?，语气自然礼貌。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 量体或询问他人身体尺寸前先说明用途并征得同意；交换尺寸时注明厘米、米等单位，避免误解。

etymology.historical_story: ukuran 由表示“测量”的 ukur 加上名词后缀 -an 构成，把测量动作转化为测量所得的结果。从裁缝记录的身体围度到工匠标注的家具长宽，这个构词关系都清楚可见。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用卷尺 ukur，再把数字写在纸上：纸上留下的尺寸就是 ukuran。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词根使用；u- 不是此词的前缀，y 表示辅音 /j/。

senses.zh_definition: 为达到某个目的而付出的努力、设想的办法或采取的手段。
senses.en_definition: Effort or means employed to achieve a particular purpose.
senses.ms_definition: Usaha untuk mencapai sesuatu tujuan; daya usaha, akal atau ikhtiar.
senses.nuances: 核心是为达成目的而寻找办法并尽力行动。在马来西亚常见于 daya upaya、segala upaya 等搭配；日常表达“努力”也常用 usaha。表示具体能力时通常使用 keupayaan。

collocations.zh: 努力与办法；所能动用的力量

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Segala daya upaya akan digembleng untuk memastikan bantuan sampai kepada mangsa banjir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 将调动一切力量，确保援助送达水灾灾民。
dual_scenarios.en: Every effort and available resource will be mobilised to ensure that aid reaches the flood victims.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dah habis daya upaya aku cuba baiki benda ni, tapi masih tak jalan.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah menggunakan segala daya upaya untuk membaiki benda ini, tetapi benda ini masih tidak berfungsi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经想尽办法修这东西了，可它还是不能用。
dual_scenarios.en: I've tried everything to fix this thing, but it still doesn't work.
spoken_features: dah、ni、tak 分别对应 sudah、ini、tidak。
tak jalan 在这里口语化地表示“不运作、不能用”。
daya upaya 保留固定搭配，整句带尽力后无奈的语气。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah habis daya upaya aku nak baiki kipas ni. Masih tak jalan.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah menggunakan segala daya upaya untuk membaiki kipas ini, tetapi kipas ini masih tidak berfungsi.
messages.zh: 我已经想尽办法修这个风扇了，还是不能用。
messages.en: I've tried everything to fix this fan, but it still won't work.

messages.speaker: Hafiz (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Rehat dulu lah. Esok kita bawa ke kedai je.
messages.ms_standard: Berehatlah dahulu. Esok kita bawa kipas itu ke kedai untuk dibaiki.
messages.zh: 先歇一下吧。明天我们直接拿去店里修。
messages.en: Take a break. Let's just take it to a repair shop tomorrow.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述自己的努力时语气通常中性；habis daya upaya 表示已经尽力，回应时宜先体谅对方，再讨论下一步。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 在马来西亚语境中，谈一般努力可用 usaha；强调已动用各种办法可用 segala daya upaya。谈个人或机构具备的能力时，宜根据句式选择 berupaya 或 keupayaan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 描述自己的努力时语气通常中性；habis daya upaya 表示已经尽力，回应时宜先体谅对方，再讨论下一步。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 在马来西亚语境中，谈一般努力可用 usaha；强调已动用各种办法可用 segala daya upaya。谈个人或机构具备的能力时，宜根据句式选择 berupaya 或 keupayaan。

etymology.historical_story: Upaya 的词源可追溯至梵语 upāya，含“方法、手段、达成目标的途径”等意思。早期马来语词典已将它记录为计策、办法及可用资源；现代用法继续保留“为了做到某事而寻找办法”的核心。[早期马来语词典记录](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/78/A_Grammar_and_Dictionary_of_the_Malay_Language_with_a_Preliminary_Disssertation-_Malay_and_English_and_English_and_Malay_Dictionaries%2C_in_Two_Volumes%2C_Vol._II_%28IA_dli.granth.52857%29.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面前有一道关着的门：找钥匙、请人帮忙、换一条路，都是朝目标动用的 upaya；记住“努力加办法”这个画面。

morphology.pattern_note: 在表示先后排列的 urut 后加名词后缀 -an；词根末尾的 t 保留，按音节读作 u.ru.tan。此处采用“顺序”义词根，不采用“按摩”义。

senses.zh_definition: 事件、步骤或项目按先后关系形成的次序或序列。
senses.en_definition: The order or sequence in which events, steps, or items follow one another.
senses.ms_definition: Susunan kejadian, langkah atau perkara yang berturut-turut atau teratur.
senses.nuances: 重点是项目之间的先后关系，不只是一般摆放或布局。urutan 另有“按摩”的同形词义，本条仅收录数据包指定的“顺序”义；参见 [DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=urutan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报：整理事故经过
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan itu menerangkan urutan peristiwa berdasarkan rakaman kamera keselamatan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该报告根据监控录像说明了事件发生的先后经过。
dual_scenarios.en: The report explains the sequence of events based on security camera footage.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp：同事核对操作步骤
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah ikut urutan langkah dalam panduan tu, tapi masih tak menjadi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah mengikuti urutan langkah dalam panduan itu, tetapi masih belum berjaya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经按指南里的步骤顺序做了，可还是不行。
dual_scenarios.en: I've followed the steps in the guide in order, but it still isn't working.
spoken_features: aku 是熟人间的第一人称。
dah 对应 sudah，tu 对应 itu。
tapi 和 tak 分别对应 tetapi 和 tidak。
tak menjadi 在此表示操作未成功。

messages.speaker: Amir (熟悉的同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah ikut urutan langkah dalam panduan tu, tapi masih tak menjadi.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah mengikuti urutan langkah dalam panduan itu, tetapi masih belum berjaya.
messages.zh: 我已经按指南里的步骤顺序做了，可还是不行。
messages.en: I've followed the steps in the guide in order, but it still isn't working.

messages.speaker: Mei (熟悉的同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Cuba tengok langkah kedua tu dulu. Mungkin ada satu bahagian yang kau tertinggal.
messages.ms_standard: Cuba semak langkah kedua itu dahulu. Mungkin ada satu bahagian yang awak tertinggal.
messages.zh: 先看看第二步吧，可能有一部分你漏掉了。
messages.en: Check the second step first. You might have missed something.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身语气中性。指出他人步骤有误时，可说 Mari kita semak urutan langkah ini，以共同检查的方式提出。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论流程、故事或事件经过时使用很自然。若语境可能涉及身体护理，可补上 peristiwa 或 langkah，明确表示“顺序”。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身语气中性。指出他人步骤有误时，可说 Mari kita semak urutan langkah ini，以共同检查的方式提出。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论流程、故事或事件经过时使用很自然。若语境可能涉及身体护理，可补上 peristiwa 或 langkah，明确表示“顺序”。

etymology.historical_story: urutan 的构词基础是表示依次排列的 urut，后缀 -an 将这种排列关系表达为名词。这个词把“一个接着一个”的关系用于事件、工作步骤和其他序列；它与表示按摩的同形词应分开记忆。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象三张卡片排成“1 → 2 → 3”；卡片之间不能随便颠倒的先后关系，就是 urutan。

morphology.pattern_note: 以元音 u 起首；加 meN- 或 peN- 时分别形成 mengundi、pengundi，词基 undi 保留。实际语音可在词首带喉塞音：[ˈʔun.di]。

senses.zh_definition: 在选举或表决中表达某项选择的一票；选票或票数中的票。
senses.en_definition: A vote expressing a choice in an election or collective decision.
senses.ms_definition: Pernyataan pilihan seseorang dalam pemilihan atau penentuan sesuatu, misalnya melalui penandaan pada kertas undi.
senses.nuances: 本条采用名词“票”的核心义，例如 mendapat seratus undi。标准叙述中的动词“投票”通常用 mengundi；口语或号召语中的 undi saya 可理解为“投我一票”。kertas undi 指承载选择的选票纸张。词义依据：[PRPM：undi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=undi)。

dual_scenarios.en: The candidate received 120 votes in the election for association chair.

ke 在句末充当口语疑问标记。
标准句可用 adakah 引出是非问句。
句中的 undi 是名词，表示被计算的票。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讨论个人投票选择时应尊重对方是否愿意透露，避免逼问或要求对方证明投给了谁。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 既可用于政治选举，也可用于协会、班级和会议表决。membuang undi 是“投票”的固定表达，其中 membuang 不应逐字理解成“丢弃”；计票时可说 mengira undi。

etymology.historical_story: 旧词义中的 undi 可以指用来决定归属或先后次序的物件，buah undi 还保留了“骰子”的旧义。今天最熟悉的用法是选举和表决中的一票；从抽签物到选票，可以看到这个词连接不同决定方式的语义脉络，参见 [PRPM：undi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=undi)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每个人把代表自己选择的小纸条投入箱中：每张表达选择的票就是一份 undi，投票的人是 pengundi。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根，无词缀；词尾 ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/。派生 menguntungkan 时，元音开头的词根采用 meN- 的 meng- 形式，保留词首 u。

senses.zh_definition: 利润；经营、交易等活动所得收入扣除相关成本和费用后的盈余。
senses.en_definition: Profit; the amount by which income from a business or transaction exceeds the associated costs and expenses.
senses.ms_definition: Lebihan pendapatan daripada kegiatan perniagaan atau perusahaan setelah ditolak modal dan perbelanjaan yang berkaitan; laba.
senses.nuances: 本条聚焦商业上的“利润”，区别于尚未扣除成本的 jualan（销售额）和 pendapatan（收入）。untung bersih 明确指净利润；日常所说的 untung 是否已扣除全部费用，需要结合上下文判断。词义依据：[DBP：untung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=untung)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身中性，可用于正式报告和日常交流。直接询问他人的利润可能涉及商业隐私，关系不熟时可先问 Boleh saya tahu…（方便请问……）。

etymology.historical_story: untung 在马来语传统表达中既与命运、际遇相连，也表示所得的利益：untung sabut timbul, untung batu tenggelam 用浮起的椰壳纤维和沉底的石头描绘不同际遇。现代商业语境则通过 untung bersih 等搭配，把这个词落实为可以核算的利润；这些并存的意义可见于 [DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=untung)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象卖糕点后，把原料、包装和其他费用逐一扣掉，最后留在钱盒里的盈余就是 untung；用“收入 − 成本费用 = untung”记住本条核心义。

morphology.pattern_note: 以上词根字段按输入包保留，将 utusan 作为独立词条处理。通常的语言学构词分析为 utus + -an → utusan；DBP 也将其列于 utus 的派生词族，不能据输入标签认定其在构词上不可分析。

word_family.gloss: 代表团；致辞；寄送的信息

senses.zh_definition: 受派遣传话、交涉或代表某一方的人或一组人；使者、特使或代表团。
senses.en_definition: A person or group sent as a messenger, envoy, or representative.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau kumpulan orang yang diutus; suruhan atau wakil.
senses.nuances: 重点是受某方派遣并代表该方，可指一个人，也可指一组人。依输入中的 DBP 释义，此处不另立“消息”义；普通短信通常称 mesej，正式致辞可称 perutusan。Utusan 出现在报刊名称中时属于专名用法。

collocations.en: to send an envoy or delegation

etymology.historical_story: Utusan belongs to the utus family, built around sending someone on a mission. The dictionary illustrates it through states sending representatives to Siam, placing the word in a diplomatic setting. Its reference can include an entire group, so English translation may require delegation rather than a single messenger. [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=utusan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把词族连起来记：utus 是“派出去”，utusan 是“派出去传话或代表办事的人”；可用“派使者”这个画面记住。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根，不拆为 u- 与 dang。ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/；词首元音在实际发音中可带喉塞音，形成 [ˈʔu.daŋ]。下列词族成员为复合表达，不是加词缀的派生词。

word_family.gloss: 罗氏沼虾等长臂淡水大虾

senses.zh_definition: 虾；生活在淡水或海水中的有硬壳、分节身体和尾部的甲壳动物，通常指可食用的虾类。
senses.en_definition: A shrimp or prawn: an aquatic crustacean with a hard outer covering, a segmented body, and a tail.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis binatang yang hidup di air, berkulit keras, berkaki sepuluh dan berekor.
senses.nuances: 日常语境中通常译为“虾”。具体名称的范围由整个复合词决定，例如 udang kara 指龙虾类，不能只按 shrimp 理解。udang 可表示一只、多只或食材这一类别；需要计数时常用 ekor。英语 prawn 与 shrimp 的选择受地区和商品名称影响。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=udang)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈食物时可直接使用。谚语 ada udang di balik batu 暗示对方另有企图，面对不熟悉的人或正式合作伙伴时，使用这一说法容易显得多疑或带有指责。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 点餐和买菜时属于中性常用词。给客人准备食物前，可礼貌询问 Boleh makan udang?，确认对方是否吃虾。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈食物时可直接使用。谚语 ada udang di balik batu 暗示对方另有企图，面对不熟悉的人或正式合作伙伴时，使用这一说法容易显得多疑或带有指责。

etymology.historical_story: Udang is treated here as a whole Malay root, without inventing smaller meaningful parts. Its cultural reach extends beyond food: the proverb ada udang di balik batu pictures a prawn hidden behind a stone. That concealed creature becomes an image for an unstated motive behind someone's apparently straightforward words or actions. [DBP proverb collection](https://jendeladbp.my/peka-bahasa-kategori/peribahasa/page/5/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 u-dang 时想象一只弯身翘尾的虾；末尾 ng 连成一个鼻音，不要读成 n 加 g。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以元音 u 开头；加 meN-、peN- 时分别采用 meng-、peng-，形成 mengurut、pengurut，保留词根全部字母。表示按摩与表示顺序的 urut 是同形词，派生词须按义项区分。

word_family.gloss: 按摩动作或效果；另一个同形词义为顺序、序列

senses.zh_definition: 用手或器械对身体部位反复按压、揉捏和摩擦；按摩。
senses.en_definition: To massage a part of the body by pressing, kneading, or rubbing it.
senses.ms_definition: Memicit, meramas dan menggosok bahagian badan dengan tangan atau alat.
senses.nuances: 原形常见于指令、口语及 minyak urut、tukang urut 等组合。正式主动陈述通常使用 mengurut；接受按摩用 berurut。词义本身不保证治疗效果。马来文释义依据 [DBP：urut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=urut) 规范化转述。

senses.zh_definition: 用手沿身体表面轻轻摩挲、抚摸或捋过。
senses.en_definition: To stroke or gently rub a part of the body with the hand.
senses.ms_definition: Mengusap atau membelai bahagian badan dengan gerakan tangan yang lembut.
senses.nuances: 此义通常以 mengurut 出现，强调抚摩而非深度揉按。mengurut dada 还可表示因失望、忧愁等而抚胸叹息。参见 [DBP：mengurut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengurut+1+)，其中另收较少见的先捏住再顺势捋动之义。

collocations.zh: 抚胸；因失望或忧愁而抚胸叹息
collocations.en: rub one's chest; figuratively, express dismay or distress

senses.zh_definition: 按次序连续排列或编号的，主要用于 angka urut、nombor urut 等固定组合。
senses.en_definition: Sequential or serial, especially of numbers arranged in order.
senses.ms_definition: Berturut-turut atau mengikut susunan bilangan, khususnya dalam ungkapan angka urut dan nombor urut.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 所列 urut II，与按摩义分开。该义主要在组合及 urutan、berurut-urut 等派生形式中使用，不宜把 urut 当成可自由替代 teratur 的通用形容词。依据 [DBP：urut II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rut)。

etymology.historical_story: In Malay cultural life, urut names a familiar practice of bodily care. Malaysia's heritage department describes traditional Malay massage and records massage within customary care surrounding childbirth. These associations explain why the word appears alongside family care and traditional practitioners. This cultural history does not establish the root's earliest linguistic origin. See [Malaysia's Department of National Heritage](https://heritage.gov.my/en/pengenalan-cawangan-adat-budaya/perubatan-tradisi.html).

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries make ungu memorable through a local natural comparison: the colour of kundang seeds. That image places an abstract colour beside something tangible. The related form keungu-unguan then softens the description to somewhat purple or purplish, allowing speakers to describe a colour impression without claiming an exact shade. See the [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=ungu).

etymology.historical_story: English umbrella came through Italian from a Latin formation associated with shade. Its history therefore points toward protection from sunshine as well as rain. The familiar canopy later supplied a metaphor for organizations or concepts that cover several others. In Malay, the ordinary word for the physical object is payung. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/umbrella).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 umbrella 想成头顶张开的保护罩：实物是“伞”，比喻是“把多个单位罩在一起”；马来语实物名记 payung。

morphology.pattern_note: 邀请义以 undang 为词根。词根以元音 u 开头，meN- 取 meng-，保留 u，形成 mengundang；peN- 相应形成 pengundang。undang-undang 的法律义属于另列同形词的重叠形式，不是“反复邀请”。

senses.nuances: 对应数据包的 undang I。正式主动陈述通常用 mengundang；词根 undang 可自然用于命令句、某些代词被动结构及熟人间口语。邀请对象通常直接跟在动词后，活动或地点可由 ke 引出。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengundang)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish several homonyms under undang: inviting, the legal vocabulary represented by undang-undang, and a customary title in Negeri Sembilan. Their shared spelling is not proof of a single historical origin. For learners, the cultural connection is useful: an invitation brings guests together, while an Undang belongs to a traditional institution. These associations aid memory without inventing an etymology. [DBP invitation entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=mengundang)；[DBP title entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=undang+III)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 undang 联想成门口“咚咚”的敲门声：客人应邀而来。另记三个外形：mengundang 邀请，undang-undang 法律，Undang 传统领袖；联想不等于词源。

etymology.historical_story: Ungkapan belongs to the family of ungkap, with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary meanings connect spoken wording, idioms, facial expression, mathematics and computing. This makes it a useful cultural bridge: feelings can take an expression on a face, while abstract ideas take an expression in symbols. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=ungkap)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ungkap 是“表达”，加 -an 就把表达变成一个“表达形式”：一句话、一个神情或一个式子。

etymology.historical_story: Umm is an Arabic word meaning mother, preserved in Malay compounds and scholarly titles. DBP records umm ulbuldan for a capital city. The theological title Umm al-Barahin also uses umm in the sense of a foundation or source. These expressions preserve a maternal metaphor within Malay religious and literary vocabulary. [Sources: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=umm), [University of Malaya study](https://ejournal.um.edu.my/index.php/afkar/article/download/15389/9298/30696)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 umm 联想到中文“母”的收唇鼻音：母亲是源头，复合词中的 umm 也常指母体或根本。这只是记忆联想。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是后接附着成分，此处通常表示第三人称所属或回指；不改变 ubat 的拼写。/ɲ/ 是一个鼻音，t 保留。所给 Jawi اوبت 对应词根 ubat；完整 ubatnya 写作 اوبتڽ。

etymology.historical_story: Ubatnya is built within Malay from ubat and the attached form -nya. Its history is best understood through ordinary reference: once a patient, illness, or problem has been mentioned, the ending points back to it. The medicine image also supports figurative expressions about soothing sadness or finding a solution. No specific deeper origin for ubat is asserted here.

etymology.historical_story: Unsur comes from Arabic ʿunṣur, meaning an element or constituent. Its Malay spelling and pronunciation show adaptation: the emphatic Arabic consonant is represented by ordinary s, while the initial pharyngeal sound is often absent. The word now connects two familiar worlds: chemical substances in classrooms and cultural or literary ingredients in everyday discussion. [Lexical source](https://archive.bukohome.com/content/wiktionary_en_all_maxi_2024-05/A/unsur)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 un-sur 联想成“一份元素”：组成物质的是元素，组成作品的是要素；两者都可用 unsur。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 加 -an 后，词根末尾的 /ŋ/ 成为末音节的声母，读作 /un.da.ŋan/；ng 表示一个辅音 /ŋ/。邀请义来自 undang I；立法机构名称中的 undangan 属于 undang II 的法律词族，须分开理解。

etymology.historical_story: DBP separates undang into different lexical families. One concerns inviting people and produces undangan for an invitation or invited guest. Another concerns laws and includes undangan in legislative-body names. Their shared spelling creates a useful cultural contrast: a wedding card welcomes guests, while Dewan Undangan Negeri names a lawmaking institution. Context selects the family. [PRPM: undang I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=undang+I), [PRPM: undang II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=undang+II%3B+undang-undang+1)

etymology.historical_story: Ulat belongs to an old Austronesian word family. The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary connects Malay ulat with reconstructed Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *qulej, referring to maggots, caterpillars and insect larvae. Related forms occur in Iban, Javanese and many island languages. Its everyday meaning therefore preserves a shared vocabulary for small creatures observed long before modern biological classification. [Source: Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/27859)

etymology.historical_story: English united is formed from unite and the participial ending -d. Unite ultimately traces to Latin forms meaning to make one, connecting the word with unity and union. Its appearance in Malay material can reflect English quotations, multilingual conversation or retained institutional names; none of those contexts alone establishes an independent Malay headword. See [the etymology of unite](https://www.etymonline.com/word/unite).

etymology.historical_story: English unicorn came through Old French from Latin forms meaning one-horned, so its name describes its defining feature. In 2013, investor Aileen Lee reused the mythical creature as a label for exceptionally valuable start-ups. The image now connects children's fantasy merchandise with business reporting, although the two meanings require very different contexts. See [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/unicorn) and [Cowboy Ventures](https://www.cowboy.vc/news/welcome-back-to-the-unicorn-club-10-years-later?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block).

etymology.historical_story: Utamanya combines the inherited Malay vocabulary item utama with the productive attached form -nya. Utama is traced to Sanskrit uttama, meaning highest or best. Its modern family develops that idea into importance and priority. The attached -nya then connects the expression to a contextual referent, rather than automatically turning every occurrence into 'especially'. [Sanskrit–Malay correspondence](https://ejournal.unimel.edu.my/index.php/JK/article/download/321/277), [DBP usage](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=utama)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 utama＝主要，再看 -nya 指谁：tujuan utamanya＝其主要目的。若整句要表达“尤其”，优先联想 terutamanya。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 连写，读 /ɲa/，词根末尾 /ŋ/ 保留；它可表达强调、名词化或第三人称领属，须按句法判断。所给 Jawi 是词根拼写，完整 untungnya 为 اونتوڠڽ。

etymology.historical_story: Malay untung connects several ideas: fate, good fortune, profit, and benefit. Traditional sayings contrast untung with malang, linking everyday outcomes with reflections on destiny. Adding -nya produces a form whose interpretation depends on its sentence: fortunate commentary, an emotional exclamation, or someone's profit or lot. These meanings grow from the root's established range, rather than from a separate borrowed word. [DBP root entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=untung)

senses.nuances: -nya 不区分男女，因此不能脱离上下文固定译作“他的”。umurnya 是带附着成分的 umur，释义据根词整理。个人年龄是最直接的用法；正式描述机构年数时，可用 usia organisasi 或 tempoh penubuhan 使所指更清楚。[DBP：umur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=umur)

etymology.historical_story: Umurnya illustrates how Malay attaches a reference to an ordinary noun: umur supplies the idea of age or life, and -nya links it to someone already understood. The resulting expression carries no male or female distinction. Its meanings connect practical age counting with wishes for a long life, showing how chronology and human wellbeing meet in one familiar word. [DBP: umur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=umur)

etymology.historical_story: Unta belongs to the Indian-derived vocabulary documented in early studies of Malay. William Maxwell's nineteenth-century manual lists the Malay form onta beside Sanskrit uṣṭra, both meaning camel. This documents an old etymological connection; it does not establish every intermediate borrowing stage. For modern learners, unta functions as one indivisible Malay noun. [Maxwell's Malay manual](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/25604/pg25604-images.html)

etymology.historical_story: Usang brings together several kinds of diminished freshness: unfilled grain, exhausted soil, worn belongings, and outdated language or ideas. Traditional Malay expressions about renewing what is usang also allow old practices to be restored rather than simply discarded. These related uses offer a cultural picture of age and renewal without proving a single historical sequence for the meanings.

etymology.historical_story: The root umum connects several ideas in Malay: the general rather than the particular, the public, and information already widely known. Adding -kan creates a verb that brings something into public knowledge. This explains the close relationship between umumkan, announcing an outcome, and pengumuman, the announcement itself. [Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=umum)

etymology.historical_story: Malay preserves a vivid everyday description of the intestines: tali perut, literally a belly cord. This image helps explain why anatomical vocabulary can remain accessible outside specialist settings. The same noun also names animal intestines served as food, while compounds such as usus kecil and usus besar identify particular anatomical sections. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=usus).

etymology.historical_story: The word belongs to a European family ultimately connected with Latin uniformis, combining the ideas of one and form. Matching clothing makes that older idea visible: members share a recognizable appearance. In Malay, the supplied dictionary records the clothing sense and beruniform, showing how the borrowed base supports Malay prefixation. Sources: [Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9U0086), [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=225468&keyword=uniform).

etymology.historical_story: Urat belongs to an old Austronesian vocabulary of bodily strands and connections. Comparative scholarship connects it with reconstructed *uRat, covering veins, sinews and related structures. Its broader associations with plant fibres, leaf veins and roots reveal a recurring image: thin lines that connect, support or carry something. See the [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/28668).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住“一条条贯通的细线”：身体里是血管、筋或神经，叶片上是叶脉，木头里是纤维与纹路。

morphology.formula: uji + kaji → uji kaji; ujikaji ialah ejaan lama yang dirangkaikan
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 按数据包保留检索标签 ujikaji；实际为 uji 与 kaji 构成的复合词，不是不可分析的单一词根。标准拼写为 uji kaji，分写不改变读音。仅加前缀的 menguji kaji 仍分写；前后同时加缀的 pengujikajian 连写。

senses.zh_definition: 实验；通过有计划的测试和观察，查明现象、检验设想或获取知识的活动。

senses.ms_definition: Ujian atau penyelidikan yang dilakukan untuk mengetahui atau memastikan sesuatu melalui percubaan.
senses.nuances: 本条保留输入键 ujikaji；DBP 明确规定现行标准拼写为 uji kaji，并将连写形式解释为尚未更新的旧术语拼写。它通常是名词；“进行实验”用 menjalankan uji kaji 或 menguji kaji。ujian 的范围更广，也可指考试、检测或考验。[DBP 拼写说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=uji+kaji)，[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=uji+kaji)。

etymology.historical_story: Uji kaji combines uji, associated with testing, and kaji, associated with investigation. Together they name an experiment. Its spelling also records a lexicographic transition: DBP explains that joined ujikaji survives in older terminology records awaiting revision. Current standard writing separates the noun, while the derived process noun pengujikajian joins its components. [DBP spelling guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=uji+kaji), [derived form](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=pengujikajian).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: uji 是“测试”，kaji 是“研究”：一边测试、一边研究，就是“实验”。念 u-ji ka-ji，正式书写记得中间留空格。

etymology.historical_story: Ulasan illustrates how Malay builds nouns with the productive suffix -an. Its familiar review sense belongs with mengulas, meaning to explain or comment. Dictionaries also record homonymous senses involving coverings and extensions. These should not be turned into an invented historical story in which one meaning necessarily developed into another. [DBP: ulasan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=ulasan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ulas 记成“展开讲”，加 -an 就得到“展开讲出来的评论或说明”；这是构词记忆，不是词源故事。

morphology.pattern_note: -an 将 ugut 名词化，表示威胁性的话语或行为；词根拼写不变，末尾 t 在 u.gu.tan 中成为后一音节的起始辅音。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于投诉、事件叙述和新闻报道。对方表达害怕时，不宜用 gurau sahaja“只是开玩笑”轻率否定其感受；朋友间戏称威胁也须有明确的共同语境。

etymology.historical_story: Ugutan illustrates Malay noun formation: ugut supplies the idea of threatening, while an makes the threatening words or communication nameable as a thing. The dictionary's example, surat ugutan, places that threat in a letter. A message on a phone can carry the same meaning, because intimidation, rather than the medium, defines the word. See [DBP: ugutan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ugutan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 ugut“威胁”，再把 -an 当成名词标签：ugutan 就是那句威胁、那条恐吓信息。

morphology.pattern_note: 本条将输入 usa 暂按国家名称缩写 USA 解读；规范书写使用大写。is_root 沿用输入标记，表示未作词缀分析，不表示它是马来语固有词根。USA 逐个读出英文字母名称，不读作 /u.sa/；所列 IPA 为英语读法。[Cambridge 发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/usa)

senses.zh_definition: 美国；美利坚合众国的英文名称 United States of America 的首字母缩写，规范写作 USA，马来语名称为 Amerika Syarikat。
senses.en_definition: USA: an initialism for the United States of America; called Amerika Syarikat in Malay.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bahasa Inggeris bagi United States of America, iaitu Amerika Syarikat (AS).
senses.nuances: 作国家专名缩写使用。DBP《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》将 US、USA 对译为 AS；上列马来语释义据此展开释写。本条对输入形式 usa 的身份判断属于推定：资料包没有提供释义，不能据此确认小写 usa 是独立的标准马来语词。status 的 official 仅对应已核实的规范缩写 USA。正式马来文通常使用 Amerika Syarikat 或 AS；USA 可见于国际名称、标签及夹用英语的交流。word_family 留空，因为没有证据支持由此派生的马来语词缀词族；音节及爪夷文保留资料包中的 null。[DBP 对译](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=us)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 普通正文应写 USA，避免将输入的小写形式 usa 当作规范拼写。熟人聊天中夹用 USA 自然可懂；例句中的 aku、kau 适合亲近朋友，与长辈、客户或不熟悉的人交流时宜改用 saya、对方称谓或姓名。

etymology.historical_story: USA comes from the initial letters of United States of America. Its relationship with Malay is visible in dictionary translation: DBP gives AS as the Malay equivalent of US and USA. Thus the same country has an English initialism, USA, and a Malay initialism, AS, corresponding to Amerika Syarikat. This is abbreviation formation rather than Malay affixation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=us), [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/usa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三个字母，三个关键词：U＝United，S＝States，A＝America；看到 USA，就对应马来语 Amerika Syarikat（AS）。

morphology.formula: uji + bakat → uji bakat（ujibakat 为非标准连写）
morphology.pattern_note: 这是 uji（测试）与 bakat（才艺、天赋）组成的复合表达，不是加缀形成的单一词根。规范拼写保留空格；读音按 uji bakat 标示。输入包的单一词根分析据此更正。[DBP：uji bakat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=uji+bakat)。

word_family.gloss: 测试才艺；为候选者试镜或试音

senses.zh_definition: 试镜、试音或才艺甄选：通过观看、聆听及评估表演能力来挑选候选人的过程。规范写作 uji bakat。
senses.en_definition: An audition: an assessment of a candidate's performing ability for selection; standard Malay spelling: uji bakat.
senses.ms_definition: Penilaian kebolehan seni seseorang calon bagi menentukan kesesuaiannya untuk dipilih, misalnya dalam lakonan, nyanyian atau penyiaran; ejaan bakunya ialah uji bakat.
senses.nuances: ujibakat 是可见的连写形式；标准词条及正式例句采用 uji bakat。它表示选拔过程，不保证获选，也不等同于普通笔试或一般工作面试。依领域分别译为试镜、试音或才艺测试。[DBP：uji bakat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=uji+bakat)。

etymology.historical_story: Uji bakat combines uji, meaning to test, with bakat, meaning talent or aptitude. Together they name the selection process familiar from acting, singing, and broadcasting. The joined spelling ujibakat represents the same expression, not a separate historical root. Standard dictionary spelling keeps the two components apart, making the relationship between testing and artistic ability immediately visible.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: uji 是“试”，bakat 是“才艺”：uji + bakat 就是“试一试才艺”，自然想到试镜、试音；书写时两词分开。

headword.jawi_note: 按数据包保留；该 Jawi 对应 urusan，尚未包含 -mu，不能视为完整词形的转写。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是 kamu 的附着式代词，在这里表示“你的”，并非派生词缀；suffix 仅描述其位于词后的形式。连接时原词不变，书写必须连写。数据包的 root_word 指直接构词基础 urusan，进一步的词根是 urus。[DBP：附着式代词拼写](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kau+terima)

word_family.gloss: 办事；与某人或机构打交道

senses.zh_definition: 你需要办理、处理或完成的事务、工作或手续。
senses.en_definition: Business, tasks or matters that you need to attend to.
senses.ms_definition: Perkara, pekerjaan atau keperluan yang perlu kamu kendalikan atau selesaikan.
senses.nuances: 整体相当于 urusan kamu，-mu 指向听话者。可涉及银行手续、申请、工作和私人事项，不限于商业交易。马来语释义根据基础词 urusan 调整，加入了第二人称所属关系。[DBP：urusan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=urusan)

senses.zh_definition: 与你有关、属于你负责范围或应由你自行决定的事情。
senses.en_definition: An affair that concerns you or falls within your responsibility or discretion.
senses.ms_definition: Hal yang berkaitan dengan diri kamu atau berada dalam tanggungjawab dan pertimbangan kamu.
senses.nuances: Itu urusanmu 可表示“那由你负责”或“那是你自己的事”，语气取决于上下文；Bukan urusanmu“与你无关”往往带有排斥或不耐烦。基础词也可表示管理、经办，其具体含义需要结合所管理的对象判断。[DBP：urusan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=urusan)

etymology.historical_story: Urusanmu is a transparent grammatical formation rather than a separate historical borrowing. Urus forms the noun urusan with -an, and the attached pronoun -mu identifies the person whose affairs are involved. The expression connects practical matters with personal responsibility. It can sound caring in a wish that someone's affairs go smoothly, or dismissive when used to exclude them from a matter. [DBP: urusan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=urusan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: urusan“事务”后面贴上 -mu“你的”：把事务贴上“你的”姓名标签，就是 urusanmu。

morphology.pattern_note: 原形无词缀。派生 mengutuhkan 时，meN- 在元音 u 前变为 meng-，保留词根首元音。

word_family.gloss: 完整性；团结稳固的状态

senses.zh_definition: 完整无损的；没有破裂、缺损或其他损坏的。
senses.en_definition: Intact and undamaged, with no broken or missing parts.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak rosak atau cacat; masih dalam keadaan lengkap dan sempurna.
senses.nuances: 强调物体保存完整，不等于崭新，也不保证机械功能正常。词义依据 [DBP PRPM：utuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=utuh)。

senses.zh_definition: 保持统一、完整而未分裂的；也形容关系、团结或信念稳固。
senses.en_definition: Whole and undivided; firm and enduring in unity or cohesion.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak berpecah atau terpisah; tetap lengkap, bersatu dan teguh.
senses.nuances: 常用于国家、社会团结、关系及立场等抽象对象；语气比一般的 baik 更庄重。此义与实物完整义共同体现整体未被破坏。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 中性偏书面，无不敬含义。用于 perpaduan、negara 或 hubungan 时，常带庄重、肯定的语气。

etymology.historical_story: An intact table and an undivided country share one image: nothing essential has broken away. Kamus Dewan records both applications of utuh, connecting physical completeness with social cohesion. This provides a useful cultural bridge to expressions about national unity. It describes documented meanings, rather than establishing an otherwise unverified ancient origin. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=utuh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 u.tuh 的两个音节想成两块紧密拼合的积木：拼得完整，没有裂开，就是 utuh。此为联想，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是附着于名词的后附成分，可表示第三人称领属，也可回指已知事物；归入 suffix 以符合字段分类。词基不变，ng 读 /ŋ/，ny 读 /ɲ/；参考读音分为 /u.aŋ.ɲa/。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的钱；属于前文所指第三方的款项。
senses.en_definition: His or her money; money belonging to a previously identified third party.
senses.ms_definition: Wang miliknya; bentuk uang dalam penggunaan bahasa Indonesia yang digabungkan dengan -nya sebagai penanda milik.
senses.nuances: 主要按印度尼西亚语理解。-nya 本身不区分男女，具体所有者由上下文确定。马来西亚正式表达通常用 wangnya 或 wang miliknya，口语常用 duit dia。以下搭配属于印尼语用法；马来西亚对应名词见 [DBP：wang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=wang)。此处释义为构词解释，并非所提供资料中不存在的 DBP 整词释义。

collocations.en: his or her money has run out
to return his or her money

senses.zh_definition: 上下文已明确的那笔钱、相应款项或所需金额。
senses.en_definition: The money or amount already identifiable from the context.
senses.ms_definition: Wang atau jumlah wang yang sudah diketahui daripada konteks, dengan -nya berfungsi sebagai penanda rujukan tertentu dalam bahasa Indonesia.
senses.nuances: 在印尼语中，-nya 不一定指某个人拥有；例如谈交易时可回指那笔款项。翻译前应先判断语境，不能一律译成“他的钱”。马来西亚标准表达可用 wang itu、bayaran itu 或 jumlah wang tersebut。

collocations.en: the money has already been transferred
how much the amount is; how much it costs

dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam edisi Malaysia, perkataan "uangnya" dalam teks asal Indonesia diterjemahkan sebagai "wangnya" apabila merujuk kepada wang milik seseorang.

etymology.historical_story: Uangnya is a grammatical combination, not a separate word requiring an independent origin story: uang means money, and -nya supplies possession or a contextually identifiable reference. It is especially relevant when Malaysians encounter Indonesian dialogue and writing. Malaysian formal usage normally favours wang, while everyday conversation often uses duit. The regional distinction matters more here than an unsupported ancient derivation. [DBP: wang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=wang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作 u-ang-nya：先抓 uang＝钱，再把 -nya 想成贴在钱袋上的指向标签：“他／她的”，也可能是“刚才说的那笔”。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根；ng 表示 /ŋ/，后面的 g 另读 /ɡ/，形成 /ŋɡ/，不可把 ngg 全读成单独的 /ŋ/。

word_family.gloss: 把木柴等堆起来；堆柴燃烧

senses.zh_definition: 堆积起来的木柴等物；柴堆或其他堆积物。
senses.en_definition: A heap or pile of wood or other material.
senses.ms_definition: Longgokan kayu dan sebagainya; timbunan atau tompokan.
senses.nuances: 本义强调物体堆积的形态，不必已经点燃。日常泛指一堆东西时，longgokan 或 timbunan 通常更直接；unggun 容易使人联想到柴堆。

senses.zh_definition: 堆起的木柴等燃烧形成的火；篝火。
senses.en_definition: A fire made by burning a heap of wood or similar material; a bonfire or campfire.
senses.ms_definition: Longgokan kayu dan sebagainya yang terbakar; api daripada longgokan tersebut.
senses.nuances: 常见形式为 api unggun，也可说 unggun api。通常指堆柴燃烧形成的火，不泛指炉火、烛火或一切火焰。

etymology.historical_story: Unggun connects two familiar images: wood gathered into a heap and that same heap burning as a communal fire. Dewan's dictionary records both meanings, alongside forms for piling material and tending a burning heap. This semantic connection explains the word's imagery; the consulted entry does not establish its earliest origin. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=unggun)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ung.gun 的两拍想成“堆柴—点火”：unggun 是堆，api unggun 是燃起来的柴堆。ng 后还要读出 g。

etymology.historical_story: English usher travelled through Middle English and Anglo-French from a word meaning doorkeeper, ultimately connected with Latin ostium, meaning door. The older doorway role helps explain today's attendant who receives people and guides them to seats. This is the English word's history; it does not establish a date of borrowing into Malay. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/usher).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读起来近似“啊—舍”；想象工作人员说“啊，这边请”，领你入座。只是记忆联想。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的附着形式，在这里表示“我的”，语法上属于后附代词；本格式归入 suffix。连接时无音变，须连写。root_word 沿用数据包的直接基础词 urusan，最终词根为 urus。headword.jawi 保留包值 اوروسن，但该值仅对应 urusan；加 -ku 的完整形式可写作 اوروسنکو。[DBP 连写说明](https://ptb.dbp.gov.my/soalanlazim/nb_soalan_lazim.aspx)

senses.zh_definition: 我需要办理或负责处理的事务、工作或手续。
senses.en_definition: Business, duties, or practical matters that I have to attend to.
senses.ms_definition: Pekerjaan, tugas atau perkara yang perlu aku uruskan.
senses.nuances: 强调说话人需要处理的事情，如办手续、工作安排或交易。urusan saya 更适合正式行政沟通；-ku 常用于熟人交流、个人叙述和文学表达。

senses.zh_definition: 我的事情或私事；涉及我本人、由我决定或负责的事项。
senses.en_definition: My own affairs or concerns, especially matters regarded as personal.
senses.ms_definition: Hal atau perkara yang berkaitan dengan diriku sendiri atau menjadi tanggungjawabku.
senses.nuances: Ini urusanku 可用于声明个人决定权。若语气强硬，尤其搭配 jangan campur，会带有拒绝干涉或划清界限的意味。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: Ini urusanku sendiri 可显得防御性较强。需要委婉表达界限时，可说 Terima kasih, biar saya uruskan sendiri，即“谢谢，让我自己处理吧”。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: Ini urusanku sendiri 可显得防御性较强。需要委婉表达界限时，可说 Terima kasih, biar saya uruskan sendiri，即“谢谢，让我自己处理吧”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds urusan from urus, associated with managing or attending to something, and the noun-forming suffix -an. Adding the attached pronoun -ku makes the matter personally mine. The resulting form carries a small social story: the same expression can identify an ordinary errand, describe a responsibility, or assert a boundary when someone interferes. [DBP guidance on attached pronouns](https://ptb.dbp.gov.my/soalanlazim/nb_soalan_lazim.aspx)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: urusan 是“事务”，-ku 是“我的”：urusan + ku，事情归我处理。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根无附加词缀；ng 表示 /ŋ/，后面的 g 仍读 /ɡ/，形成 /ŋ.ɡ/。

senses.zh_definition: 卓越的；出众的；在品质、才智、能力或表现等方面优于同类的。
senses.en_definition: Outstanding or superior to others in quality, ability, or achievement.
senses.ms_definition: Melebihi atau mengatasi yang lain dari segi kebaikan, kebijaksanaan, kecekapan dan sebagainya; terbaik atau teristimewa.
senses.nuances: 强调同类比较中的突出地位，比普通的 baik（好）评价更强。常见于人物表彰、教育目标及专业评价；与 ulung（杰出的、首屈一指的）意义相近，但不能据此互换所有搭配。

etymology.historical_story: The Javanese dictionary records unggul with meanings involving winning, distinction, and rising above surrounding things. That combination offers a useful regional comparison with Malay excellence. It does not, by itself, establish the date or direction of borrowing. Modern Malay treats unggul as an independent root. [Official Javanese dictionary](https://kbji.kemendikdasmen.go.id/kata/munggul)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ung-gul 的两个音节想成登上两级领奖台：高出同类，就是“卓越、出众”。这只是记忆画面，不是构词分析。

morphology.pattern_note: 意大利语音乐术语，整体记忆；不涉及马来语词缀或音变。/un/ 为意大利语读音，未核实独立的马来语规范读音。

senses.nuances: 限音乐专业语境，不作为日常马来语 satu 的替代词。pos 的 adjective 对应其意大利语数量限定功能；所给词性枚举缺少 numeral 和 determiner。DBP 的例子 una corda 使用相关形式 una，并非 un 的马来语派生词。[DBP PRPM：un 音乐术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=un)。

etymology.historical_story: Un belongs to the Italian vocabulary encountered in musical directions. Italian also has the related forms uno and una. In music, these small grammatical words remain inside expressions that performers learn as complete instructions. Malay reference terminology records un with the meaning satu. This establishes a specialist musical use, but does not establish when the form first entered Malaysian usage. [Italian forms](https://www.open.edu/openlearn/languages/beginners-italian-food-and-drink/content-section-5), [musical use](https://www.musicca.com/dictionary/italian/un).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /un/ 与英语 one 联想：先记“一”，再把 un poco 整体记成“一点点”。这是记忆联想，不是英语词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留资料包的直接词基 usahakan；更深层词根是 usaha。-kan 构成及物动词，-nya 通常指代宾语。连接时不发生词基音变。无 meN- 的形式可用于祈使句及适当的代词式被动结构；普通主动陈述通常用 mengusahakannya。

word_family.gloss: 被设法办成；被经营或耕作

senses.zh_definition: 设法把它办成；为实现、取得或完成所指事项而采取行动。
senses.en_definition: To work towards achieving, obtaining, or completing it; in an imperative, work on it or try to make it happen.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan ikhtiar atau tindakan yang diperlukan untuk mencapai, memperoleh atau menyempurnakan perkara yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: -nya 通常回指一件事、某个目标或所需资源，而不是“他的努力”。祈使句 Usahakannya 要求对方采取行动，但本身不保证成功。释义依据 usaha 词族中的 mengusahakan，针对当前词形作语法调整，并非独立词条的逐字引文。[DBP 词族释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=usaha)

senses.ms_definition: Mengurus, menjalankan atau mengerjakan perusahaan, projek atau tanah yang dirujuk supaya berfungsi atau memberikan hasil.
senses.nuances: 具体译法由 -nya 的先行词决定：土地可译为“耕作、开发”，企业可译为“经营”。不要一律译为抽象的“努力”。普通主动句宜用 mengusahakannya。

etymology.historical_story: The deeper base usaha belongs to Malay’s Indic vocabulary and is traced to Sanskrit utsāha, associated with energy and endeavour, through Pali ussāha. Malay builds its own grammatical family around this inherited borrowing. Usahakannya combines the action-forming -kan with referential -nya, turning the idea of effort into action directed towards something already mentioned. [Etymological account](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/usaha)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: usaha＝努力，-kan＝把行动指向对象，-nya＝它：usahakannya，就是“设法把它做起来”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + ujung → ujung；与 hujung 对应的口语形式
morphology.pattern_note: hujung 的词首 /h/ 脱落形成 ujung，属于词首音脱落，不是前缀删除。下列词族属于其对应标准词 hujung。

word_family.gloss: 末端；结尾；对应的标准形式
有末端；以某种结果告终

senses.zh_definition: 长形物体或延伸空间的末端、尽头，如道路或绳子的末端。
senses.en_definition: The end or extremity of an elongated object or space.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk percakapan bagi hujung: bahagian akhir sesuatu yang panjang, seperti jalan atau tali.
senses.nuances: DBP 将 ujung 标为 bahasa percakapan。以下按对应词 hujung 展开义项，马来文为编辑释义；搭配中的 ujung 属口语写法，正式文本用 hujung。[DBP：ujung 及词首音脱落](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ujung+hujung)

senses.zh_definition: 一段时间的末尾，如月末、年末；在 hujung minggu 中通常指周末。
senses.en_definition: The final part of a period; in hujung minggu, the weekend.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian akhir sesuatu tempoh, seperti bulan atau tahun; dalam frasa hujung minggu, merujuk kepada akhir minggu.
senses.nuances: ujung bulan、ujung minggu 是口语形式；正式写作使用 hujung bulan、hujung minggu。周末这一固定表达不宜机械理解为星期的最后一刻。[DBP：hujung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=hujung)

senses.zh_definition: 谈话、会议或其他过程的结尾、结束部分。
senses.en_definition: The concluding part of a conversation, meeting, or other proceeding.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian penutup atau kesudahan sesuatu percakapan, pertemuan atau kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 对应 hujung 的过程结束义。口语可用 ujung；正式报道与会议记录使用 hujung、akhir 或 penghujung，具体依句式选择。

senses.zh_definition: 远离中心或说话者的边缘地带、最远一头。
senses.en_definition: The far end or outer edge of an area, away from its centre or the speaker.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian sesuatu kawasan yang jauh dari pusat atau dari orang yang bercakap, lazimnya berhampiran tepi kawasan itu.
senses.nuances: 侧重相对位置，并不必然表示行政意义上的郊区，也不表示偏僻落后。

collocations.en: the far end of the village

senses.zh_definition: 物体突出、尖细或最前端的部分，如铅笔尖或鼻尖。
senses.en_definition: The tip or projecting extremity of an object or body part.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian paling hadapan, menonjol atau meruncing pada sesuatu benda atau anggota badan.
senses.nuances: 并非所有 ujung 都尖锐：ujung hidung 指鼻尖的位置，ujung pensel 则通常兼有尖细形状。

senses.zh_definition: 陆地向海中或水域伸出的末端。
senses.en_definition: The projecting end of a stretch of land extending into water.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian daratan yang menonjol atau menganjur ke laut atau perairan lain.
senses.nuances: 这是对应词 hujung 的地理义，日常频率低于道路尽头和时间末尾义。正式地理说明用 hujung；专名则保留其既定拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 话语所指向的用意、旨意。
senses.en_definition: The intended point or purport of an utterance.
senses.ms_definition: Maksud atau tujuan yang hendak disampaikan melalui sesuatu percakapan.
senses.nuances: 这是对应词 hujung 的较少见引申义；下列为释义性短语，不应视作已核实的高频搭配。现代日常表达通常直接用 maksud，不能把任何 ujung percakapan 都解作话语用意。

to understand the purport of someone's words

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies ujung as a conversational counterpart of hujung and explicitly uses the pair to illustrate apheresis, the loss of an initial sound. The relationship therefore offers a practical lesson in Malay register: a form heard in everyday speech may have a different preferred spelling in formal Malaysian writing. [DBP explanation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ujung+hujung)

etymology.historical_story: Ultralink and UltraLink appear in modern naming rather than one verified Malay word history. Gentec uses Ultralink for smart-home products, while a 2024 research paper names a multilingual training dataset UltraLink. These separate uses show why context matters. Their existence does not establish a shared origin, a Malay borrowing date, an official pronunciation, or a dictionary meaning for the lowercase form supplied here.

etymology.historical_story: Usia belongs to the Sanskrit-derived vocabulary of Malay. Today it functions as an ordinary word for age, while the attached form -nya identifies whose age is meant. The same expression can describe a person's years or an institution's history, linking biological age with the cultural habit of marking anniversaries. [Linguistic research](https://eprints.lancs.ac.uk/id/eprint/133438/1/11003469.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 usia＝年龄，再接 -nya＝他／她／它的：usianya 就是“其年龄”；-nya 不标性别。

morphology.pattern_note: 按专名整词记忆，不套用马来语词缀分析。数据包没有语境或权威发音，故不指定标准马来语 IPA；若指漫威角色，正文应写 Ultron。

senses.zh_definition: 奥创：漫威作品中具有人工智能的机器人角色之名，通常与复仇者联盟对立。
senses.en_definition: Ultron, the name of an artificially intelligent robotic character in Marvel stories, typically an adversary of the Avengers.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi watak robot ber kecerdasan buatan dalam karya Marvel yang lazimnya menjadi musuh Avengers.
senses.nuances: 此义采用常见的漫威角色解读；缺少原始语境，不能据小写 ultron 排除品牌或其他同名对象。pos 的 noun 在此指专有名词。数据包未提供 DBP 定义，不能标为已核实的官方马来语普通词；马来文释义为编辑说明。下列搭配是自然的专名短语，不代表已有搭配频率统计。[Marvel：Ultron](https://share.marvel.com/comics/discover/188/ultron-the-living-automaton)

etymology.historical_story: Ultron belongs to the vocabulary of fictional names, not to an established Malay derivational family. Marvel presents the character as an artificial creation of Hank Pym and a dangerous opponent of the Avengers. That fictional origin explains the character, but does not establish the linguistic derivation of the name itself. [Marvel](https://share.marvel.com/comics/discover/188/ultron-the-living-automaton)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ultron 整体连到“奥创”那张金属机器人脸上；这是角色名，不是“机器人”的马来语通称。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成表示雕刻成果或相关技艺的名词；词干字母保持不变，末尾 r 随后接元音构成 ran 音节。资料包将 ukiran 标作词根，此处按实际构词更正为 ukir。

senses.zh_definition: 雕刻、镌刻而成的图案、纹饰或作品。
senses.en_definition: A design, ornament, or object produced by carving or engraving.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang telah diukirkan; lukisan dan sebagainya yang terukir.
senses.nuances: 侧重看得见的雕刻成果，可以位于木材、石材或金属等材料上，并不限于独立摆放的雕塑。此义依据资料包所引《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》。

senses.zh_definition: 雕刻的技艺、做法或艺术表现，强调雕刻作品体现的工艺。
senses.en_definition: The craft, technique, or artistic manner of carving.
senses.ms_definition: Hasil daripada mengukir; cara mengukir.
senses.nuances: 与第一义紧密相连：第一义指具体纹饰或作品，此义着重作品背后的技艺和雕刻方式。明确指制作过程时，pengukiran 更直接。

etymology.historical_story: Ukiran is transparently formed from ukir with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its cultural associations extend from decorated buildings to finely worked personal objects. Malaysia's national handicraft agency describes master carvers making keris fittings, walking sticks, beds, and house components, showing how carving links practical objects with artistic skill. [Kraftangan Malaysia](https://kraftangan.gov.my/en/info/master-craftsmen/allahyarham-tengku-ibrahim-bin-tengku-wook).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ukir 是“雕刻”，加 -an 就想到“雕刻出来的东西”：门上的 ukiran，就是雕花。

morphology.pattern_note: 韩语 언니 的常见非正式拉丁字母写法，规范罗马字写作 eonni。所列音标为韩语读音，不表示已有统一马来语读音；整词记忆，无可核实的马来语词缀派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 姐姐；韩语中女性称呼或指称比自己年长的姐妹或女性堂表亲的用语。
senses.en_definition: An older sister or older female cousin, addressed or referred to by a female speaker in Korean.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Korea yang digunakan oleh penutur perempuan untuk memanggil atau merujuk kakak atau sepupu perempuan yang lebih tua daripadanya.
senses.nuances: 这是韩语称谓的转写，未核实其为 DBP 正式马来语词条。一般马来语对应表达为 kakak；这里的马来语释义为说明性翻译。传统韩语用法取决于说话者性别，男性称姐姐通常用 nuna。参见 [韩国国立国语院：언니](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=31971&nation=eng)。

senses.zh_definition: 姐姐；女性对比自己年长且关系亲近的女性所用的亲昵称呼，不要求存在亲属关系。
senses.en_definition: An affectionate Korean term used by a female speaker for an older woman with whom she is familiar.
senses.ms_definition: Panggilan mesra dalam bahasa Korea yang digunakan oleh perempuan kepada perempuan lain yang lebih tua, walaupun mereka tidak mempunyai hubungan kekeluargaan.
senses.nuances: 在韩流相关交流中可被保留为外语称呼，但不能当作马来西亚所有场合通用的敬称。以下为说明性搭配，未声称存在高频马来语搭配统计。亲昵称呼义见 [韩国国立国语院：언니](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=31971&nation=eng)。

etymology.historical_story: Unnie represents Korean 언니, conventionally romanized eonni. The word belongs to a system of relationship terms that identifies both relative age and the speaker's gender. A younger woman uses it for an older sister and, affectionately, an older female acquaintance. The spelling unnie should be understood as a foreign rendering, not evidence of Malay standardization. [Source: National Institute of Korean Language](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=31971&nation=eng).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 unnie 的声音联想到“欧尼”：女生叫年长女生“姐姐”。联想只帮助记忆，不代表汉语词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 元音起首的独立词根；词首可出现非区别性的喉塞音 [ʔ]。meN- 接元音时用 meng-，构成 mengusir，词根不脱音。

senses.zh_definition: 迫使人或动物离开某处；驱赶、逐走。
senses.en_definition: To force a person or animal to leave; to drive away or expel.
senses.ms_definition: Menyuruh seseorang atau binatang pergi dengan paksa; menghalau.
senses.nuances: 现代常用义。主动陈述句通常用 mengusir；usir 常用于祈使句、口语省略词缀的句子及第一、第二人称被动结构，如 orang yang mereka usir。对人使用时带明显排斥意味。参见 [PRPM：usir 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1.aspx?d=73980&keyword=pengusir)。

senses.zh_definition: 跟随追赶；为追上或擒获而追逐、追捕。
senses.en_definition: To follow in pursuit; to chase or hunt down.
senses.ms_definition: Mengikut, memburu atau mengejar seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 见于古典叙事及较旧的用法，现代日常表达通常选 mengejar 或 memburu。此义强调追赶对象，不能一律译作“赶走”。以下搭配属于旧式用法。参见 [PRPM：mengusir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=layaknya)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 对人说 Usir dia! 语气强硬，容易让人感到羞辱或被排斥。礼貌请人离开时可用 Sila beredar，或说明需要离开的原因。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述实际驱赶、逐离或排斥行为。招待客人、与长者交谈或处理服务场景时，不宜把 usir 当作普通的“请离开”。

etymology.historical_story: Older Malay narratives use mengusir for following or pursuing, including chasing a departing boat. Modern readers more readily associate the same root with driving somebody away. These documented senses involve different directions of action: moving after a target or making a target leave. Context therefore matters when reading historical prose. See [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=layaknya).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 u.sir 两拍想成朝外挥手的两下动作：“出去、出去！”记住现代常用义“驱赶”；古文另可指追赶。

etymology.historical_story: Utah preserves a historical connection with the Ute people. The Library of Congress notes that yutta, a variant of Ute, appeared on maps by 1720 and that Utah became the territorial name in 1850. This history connects the modern place-name with Indigenous peoples and earlier mapping traditions; it does not support interpreting the name through Malay morphology. [Source: Library of Congress](https://blogs.loc.gov/maps/2016/04/the-state-formerly-known-as-deseret/).

etymology.historical_story: Urk is a Dutch place name, not a Malay formation. Its municipal history records the name in 966 and describes how encroaching seawater encouraged a farming community to turn towards fishing. That history explains the town’s maritime associations, but does not establish the original meaning of its name. [Source: Gemeente Urk](https://www.urk.nl/de-tijdlijn-van-urk).

etymology.historical_story: Urus niaga brings together urus, associated with handling affairs, and niaga, associated with trade. Its structure makes commercial dealings easy to recognise. Standard spelling preserves the space, even though joined forms appear in public usage. The derivatives illustrate Malay compound spelling: berurus niaga remains separate, whereas mengurusniagakan joins the components when both prefix and suffix are attached.

etymology.historical_story: University ultimately reflects Latin universitas, a whole or corporate body. In medieval Europe, this could describe an organised community of teachers and students rather than a collection of buildings. The institutional meaning developed around that scholarly community. For Malay learners, the useful modern distinction is between English university and the standard Malay equivalent universiti. [Oxford: universitas](https://www.cabinet.ox.ac.uk/universitas-original-meaning-term).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 university 的 /juːnɪ-/，联想口语 uni 和大学校园；写规范马来语时，把词尾记成 universiti 的 -ti。

etymology.historical_story: Usul preserves several meanings that dictionaries separate into different entries. Modern readers encounter it in meeting motions, family origins, and the expression usul periksa for careful inquiry. Its Jawi spelling, اصول, also reflects its connection with Arabic vocabulary concerning roots and foundations, although that connection alone does not establish the history of every Malay sense. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=usul)

etymology.historical_story: Under is identified by the consulted bilingual dictionary as an English word with several Malay equivalents. In a mixed workplace conversation, it can express supervision without being translated. That usage should be distinguished from an established Malay borrowing. The packet provides no evidence dating its entry into Malaysian speech, so no specific borrowing period or historical pathway can be assigned.

etymology.historical_story: Umum comes from Arabic ʿumūm, associated with generality and comprehensiveness. Malay combines this borrowed base with its own ending -nya to form umumnya. The result is an everyday tool for discussing a broad picture while allowing exceptions. Related Malay formations, including pengumuman, show how the borrowed base participates in local word formation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 umum 记成“普遍、整体”，再把 umumnya 连着 pada 或 secara 一起记：把镜头拉远，看总体。阿拉伯语来源可参见[马来语阿拉伯借词研究](https://oarep.usim.edu.my/server/api/core/bitstreams/b38963e9-99b5-417c-af79-7f0f570e28db/content)。

morphology.formula: ubah + suai → ubah suai；ubahsuai 为非标准连写形式
morphology.pattern_note: is_root 与 root_word 保留资料包的索引分析；实际标准形式是复合词 ubah suai。仅加前缀时仍分写，如 mengubah suai；加 peN-…-an 时合写为 pengubahsuaian。元音前 meN-、peN- 分别呈 meng-、peng-。

word_family.gloss: 修改、改装或装修的行为与过程

senses.zh_definition: 修改、调整或改装现有事物，使其适合特定条件、需要或用途；用于建筑时可指改建、装修。
senses.en_definition: To modify or adapt something to suit particular conditions, needs, or uses; to renovate premises.
senses.ms_definition: Membuat perubahan pada sesuatu supaya sesuai dengan keadaan, keperluan atau kegunaan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 规范拼写为 ubah suai，须分写；输入形式 ubahsuai 作为检索键保留，不能标为规范拼写。主动陈述通常用 mengubah suai，名词用 pengubahsuaian；祈使句或 tertentu 结构可用 ubah suai。意义不限于房屋装修，也可涉及设备、系统和方法。本条马来语释义为依据 DBP 编写的释义，并非逐字引文。参见 [DBP 释义及拼写答复](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ubah+suai)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于工作讨论时语气中性。提出修改他人方案，可用 Bolehkah kita mengubah suai…，比直接命令 Ubah suai ini 更委婉。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式文件、报价和工程说明使用 ubah suai、mengubah suai 或 pengubahsuaian 的规范形式。该词只表示修改或改造，本身不保证改动获得许可，也不必然意味着全面重建。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于工作讨论时语气中性。提出修改他人方案，可用 Bolehkah kita mengubah suai…，比直接命令 Ubah suai ini 更委婉。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式文件、报价和工程说明使用 ubah suai、mengubah suai 或 pengubahsuaian 的规范形式。该词只表示修改或改造，本身不保证改动获得许可，也不必然意味着全面重建。

etymology.historical_story: This expression pairs ubah, conveying change, with suai, conveying suitability. Its structure links alteration with making something fit a purpose. DBP treats ubah suai as a compound written with a space. The related noun pengubahsuaian is written together, illustrating how Malay compound spelling changes when a circumfix surrounds the base. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ubah+suai).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ubah＝改变，suai 联想 sesuai＝合适：改到合适，就是 ubah suai。两个词分开写，一起表达一个动作。

morphology.pattern_note: 本族词根，u 与 bi 分成两个音节；ber- + ubi → berubi，不发生鼻音替换。ubi-ubian 由重叠加 -an 构成，表示多种薯类。

senses.zh_definition: 薯；薯块；某些植物膨大的地下茎或根，通常可食用。
senses.en_definition: A usually edible swollen underground stem or root of certain plants.
senses.ms_definition: Batang bawah tanah atau akar tumbuhan tertentu yang membesar untuk menyimpan makanan dan biasanya boleh dimakan.
senses.nuances: 是日常类别词，不只指薯蓣或紫薯；范围包括木薯、番薯和马铃薯等。植物学上块茎与块根不同，但日常马来语可统称 ubi。具体种类须看后接限定词或语境。词义依据：[DBP：ubi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ubi-ubian)。

senses.zh_definition: 薯类植物；能形成薯块的植物，具体种类由限定词或上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A plant that produces edible tubers or tuberous roots.
senses.ms_definition: Tumbuhan yang menghasilkan ubi, seperti ubi kayu, keledek atau kentang.

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 薯类既是传统食材，也常用于糕点和点心，不宜把吃薯类直接说成贫困或落后的象征。俗语 diam-diam ubi 用薯块在地下生长的形象赞许安静却有本事或有成果的人。

etymology.historical_story: Ubi belongs to an old Austronesian word family reconstructed as Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *qubi. Related forms appear across languages for yams and other underground food crops. Malay uses the inherited word broadly, adding names such as kayu, keledek and kentang to distinguish crops. This history explains why translating every occurrence as yam loses information: the Malay category extends across several botanically different foods. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-w_u.htm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: u.bi 可借英语谐音想成“you dig”：往地下挖，挖出薯块。ubi 是总类，后面的 kayu、keledek、kentang 才告诉你是哪一种；这是记忆联想，不是词源。

morphology.formula: ∅ + ups → ups（非正式感叹形式）；U + P + S → UPS（首字母缩略形式）
morphology.pattern_note: 不能仅凭小写词形确定读音或词类。感叹形式可读 /ups/；英语字母名称读出的 UPS 为 /ˌjuː.piːˈes/。这些形式没有共同的马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 哎呀；糟了：在非正式文字中表示刚发现小失误、疏漏或意外的感叹形式。
senses.en_definition: An informal exclamation acknowledging a minor mistake, omission, or mishap; oops.
senses.ms_definition: Ungkapan tidak formal untuk menyatakan bahawa penutur baru menyedari kesilapan kecil, kecuaian atau kejadian yang tidak disengajakan.
senses.nuances: 仅作为可能的语境解读；输入未提供 DBP 释义，不能认定 ups 是已获规范认可的马来西亚马来语词。实际语法功能是 kata seru，本结构因没有 interjection 选项而归入 particle。英语 oops 的释义可参见 [Cambridge：oops](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/oops)，但这不能证明 ups 的马来语规范地位。

senses.zh_definition: 不间断电源：在主电源中断时为连接设备提供备用电力的装置，规范缩写为 UPS。
senses.en_definition: An uninterruptible power supply: a device that provides backup power when the main supply fails.
senses.ms_definition: Bekalan kuasa tanpa gangguan, iaitu peranti yang membekalkan kuasa sandaran kepada peralatan apabila bekalan elektrik utama terputus.
senses.nuances: 这是大写 UPS 的技术义项；仅在电源、电脑或设备语境下适用。UPS 是英语 uninterruptible power supply 的首字母缩写，不按单词 ups 的感叹读音读。参见 [APC：UPS 说明](https://www.apc.com/us/en/support/product-support/ups-buying-guide-for-selecting-a-battery-backup-system.jsp)。

senses.zh_definition: 联合包裹服务公司，名称缩写为 UPS；在快递语境中也可指其承运服务。
senses.en_definition: United Parcel Service, abbreviated UPS; also its delivery service in shipping contexts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama ringkas United Parcel Service, sebuah syarikat penghantaran bungkusan dan logistik.
senses.nuances: 这是大写专名 UPS，须与不间断电源的技术缩写及非正式感叹形式区分。包裹、运单和快递语境有助于消歧。公司名称参见 [UPS：公司历史](https://about.ups.com/us/en/our-company/our-history.html)。

etymology.historical_story: These letters conceal different histories. Technical UPS expands to uninterruptible power supply. The delivery company's initials represent United Parcel Service, a name adopted in 1919. Informal ups resembles the exclamation oops, but the packet establishes neither its borrowing route nor official Malay status. Context must therefore decide which history applies. Sources: [APC](https://www.apc.com/us/en/support/product-support/ups-buying-guide-for-selecting-a-battery-backup-system.jsp), [UPS](https://about.ups.com/us/en/our-company/our-history.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看语境记三路：小失误 ups＝哎呀；电池 UPS＝备用电源；包裹 UPS＝快递公司。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -kan 接于 undur，词根不变音；可用于祈使句，也可用于第一、第二人称被动结构，如 Kereta itu saya undurkan。普通主动陈述通常用 mengundurkan。音节可分析为 un.dur.kan；输入未提供，故 syllables 保留 null。输入 jawi 为词根拼写，完整词形应补上后缀：اوندورکن。

senses.zh_definition: 把物体向后移动；使车辆倒退；把钟表拨回较早的时间。
senses.en_definition: Move something backwards, reverse a vehicle, or set a clock back.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalihkan sesuatu ke arah belakang atau mengubah bacaan jam kepada waktu yang lebih awal.
senses.nuances: 属于及物用法，常见于操作指示。undur 或 berundur 可表示主体自己后退；undurkan 通常要求说明被移动的对象。以下义项按 [DBP：mengundurkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=mengundurkan) 整合释写。

senses.zh_definition: 命令或使人员、部队从原有位置后撤。
senses.en_definition: Order or cause personnel or troops to withdraw from a position.
senses.ms_definition: Mengarahkan atau menyebabkan anggota atau pasukan beralih ke belakang atau meninggalkan kedudukan asal.
senses.nuances: 强调使他人撤退。描述部队自行撤退时通常用 berundur；描述指挥者下令撤军时用 mengundurkan pasukan。

collocations.en: pull personnel back to a safe area

senses.zh_definition: 把原定日期、活动或行动延至较晚的时间。
senses.en_definition: Postpone an event or action to a later time.
senses.ms_definition: Mengubah waktu yang telah ditetapkan kepada waktu yang lebih lewat.
senses.nuances: 这里的时间方向是延后；与 undurkan jam 的拨回较早时间不同。正式安排宜明确新日期，避免单说 undurkan seminggu 而产生理解偏差。

senses.zh_definition: 用于 undurkan diri：退出活动或关系，辞去职务，或告辞离开场合。
senses.en_definition: In undurkan diri, withdraw from participation, resign from a position, or take one's leave.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan undurkan diri, menarik diri daripada penyertaan atau jawatan, atau meninggalkan sesuatu tempat atau majlis.
senses.nuances: diri 是这一惯用结构的重要组成部分。退出职务通常接 daripada；离开地点通常接 dari。undurkan diri 可以是礼貌告辞，不一定表示辞职。

etymology.historical_story: Undurkan illustrates how Malay builds related meanings around bodily movement. Its base undur concerns moving backwards; -kan makes that movement affect something else. The same image extends to withdrawing troops, delaying a departure, and stepping away from a position. These connections explain the word's semantic family without requiring an unverified story about its earliest origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 undur 想成“往后退”，-kan 想成“让它这样做”：undurkan kereta 就是“让车往后退”。

etymology.historical_story: UK is formed from the initials of the English name United Kingdom. Malaysian official documents use this abbreviation alongside other international country labels. Its presence in Malay writing therefore reflects the use of an English initialism. A lowercase corpus token may have lost its original capitalization, but that explanation remains conditional without context.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: U 取自 United，K 取自 Kingdom；逐字母读“you kay”，标准拼写用大写 UK。

etymology.historical_story: English union came through French from Latin unio, expressing oneness or unity. Its meanings developed from joining together to organized bodies, including associations of workers. This shared idea explains why a political union and a trade union use the same English noun. It does not establish union as an officially adopted Malay headword. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/union)

etymology.historical_story: The packet does not establish a Malay word uss. Capitalized USS instead illustrates how abbreviations travel between languages: naval writing uses it for United States Ship, while Singapore tourism uses it for Universal Studios Singapore. These unrelated expansions share three letters. Context and capitalization, rather than Malay affixation, determine their interpretation.

etymology.historical_story: Uangmu illustrates how a shared grammatical resource can accompany different regional vocabulary. Indonesian commonly uses uang where Malaysian Malay normally uses wang or duit. The attached pronoun -mu contributes the meaning your. The transparent formation therefore helps readers understand cross-border messages, without implying that uangmu is an independently established Malaysian dictionary headword.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 -mu＝你的：uang 是钱，uangmu 就是“你的钱”；在马来西亚日常可对应 duit awak。

etymology.historical_story: Ukraine is an international country name associated with Ukrainian Ukraina. A corresponding historical term occurs in a chronicle entry for 1187, long before the modern state. Scholars debate its earliest geographical meaning, including interpretations involving territory and borderlands. Malay uses Ukraine as an indivisible proper name; its historical background does not supply Malay prefixes or determine the country's present political identity. [Historical discussion](https://history.org.ua/LiberUA/978-963-9776-26-5/978-963-9776-26-5.pdf)

word_family.gloss: 药；某些传统语境中也指符药或咒术用品

senses.zh_definition: 咒语、符咒或巫术；传统叙事中被认为能够产生超自然作用的法术。
senses.en_definition: Incantations, charms, or sorcery in traditional belief and narrative.
senses.ms_definition: Jampi-jampi, guna-guna, mantera atau sihir.
senses.nuances: 这是输入所引《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》的词义。主要见于传统故事、文学及相关文化讨论。下列搭配属于此类语境，不代表现代日常高频表达。[DBP：ubatan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=ubatan)

senses.zh_definition: 药物；用于治疗的药用物质，常见于专业术语及修饰其他名词的结构。
senses.en_definition: A medicinal substance or preparation, especially in technical usage and attributive expressions.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan atau sediaan yang digunakan untuk tujuan rawatan; dalam penggunaan atributif, berkaitan dengan kegunaan sebagai ubat.
senses.nuances: 这是依据 DBP 术语记录概括的现代用法，并非把旧词典的巫术义改写成药物义。DBP 记录有 medicant → ubatan、bahan ubatan 和 tumbuhan ubatan。一般谈药物时，ubat 或 ubat-ubatan 更稳妥。[DBP：相关术语记录](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=ubatan)

etymology.historical_story: Ubatan illustrates how one word family can connect healing vocabulary with older accounts of supernatural power. The supplied dictionary example places it beside a pawang, an elephant handler associated with esoteric knowledge. Modern terminology also uses ubatan for medicinal substances and plants. Context therefore matters: a traditional narrative and a research report may activate different meanings. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=ubatan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ubat 是“药”，加 -an 成 ubatan；读故事先想“咒术”，见 tumbuhan ubatan 则想“药用植物”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根无需拆分。meN- 接元音起首的 usik 时采用 meng-，形成 mengusik；马来西亚常见发音中，词尾 k 实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。

senses.zh_definition: 对别人的打扰、逗弄或捉弄行为。
senses.en_definition: An act of disturbing, teasing, or bothering someone.

senses.nuances: 这是词根的名词义；现代日常表达中，表示一次或一类逗弄行为时，usikan 往往更自然。词义及派生义参见 [DBP：usik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=usik)。

senses.zh_definition: 以开玩笑的方式逗弄、打趣某人。

senses.ms_definition: Mengganggu atau menggoda seseorang secara bermain-main.
senses.nuances: 常见于熟人互动。裸词 usik 自然用于口语和祈使句；正式主动陈述句通常使用 mengusik。是否友善取决于双方关系及被逗弄者的感受。

senses.zh_definition: 触碰、摆弄或擅自动用某物；干预他人的事务。

etymology.historical_story: Usik belongs to an established Malay word family linking physical disturbance with social interaction. A hand can disturb an object, a joke can disturb someone's composure, and a remembered song can leave feelings terusik. These related uses offer a cultural picture of teasing and sensitivity; they do not establish a particular borrowing history.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 usik 的短促收尾想成轻轻戳一下：戳朋友是逗弄，戳物品是碰动，戳到痛处就是冒犯。此为意义联想，不是词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: Usahawan combines usaha with -wan, a person-forming suffix borrowed into Malay from Sanskrit. The formation connects enterprise with the person undertaking it. Its related noun keusahawanan extends the focus from an individual business operator to entrepreneurial activities and skills, making the family useful in education, business training, and public discussion. [DBP on Sanskrit suffixes](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=akhiran), [DBP, usahawan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=usahawan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: usaha＝努力、经营；-wan＝从事相关事业的人。usaha + -wan → usahawan：把事业经营起来的人。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语短语首字母缩写，按整体借入，不作马来语词缀拆分。规范书写通常为大写 UFO；此处保留输入词键 ufo。IPA 表示按马来语字母名称逐字母读出的形式，不排除其他实际读法。syllables 与 jawi 的 null 保留数据包缺值。

etymology.historical_story: UFO comes from the English initials of unidentified flying object. Its history is closely associated with twentieth-century investigations of unusual aerial sightings: the United States established Project Blue Book in 1952 to collect and evaluate reports. The Malay entry preserves the English abbreviation while explaining its meaning in Malay. [US National Archives history](https://prologue.blogs.archives.gov/2019/12/19/saucers-over-washington-the-history-of-project-blue-book/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个字母接回原句：U＝unidentified，不明；F＝flying，飞行；O＝object，物体。先记“不明”，不要直接跳成“外星”。

morphology.pattern_note: 在《哈利·波特》语境中作为完整专名记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分；规范书写首字母大写。IPA 为该英文姓名的读法，并非已核定的马来语标准读音。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合文学、影视和粉丝交流，规范写作使用大写 Umbridge。不能把它当作普通马来语中“残酷”或“官僚”的正式同义词。

etymology.historical_story: J. K. Rowling explains that Umbridge deliberately echoes the English word umbrage, meaning offence or resentment. The surname reflects a character who reacts badly when her narrow worldview is challenged. This is an author-created literary name, not a Malay derivation, and its resemblance to an English expression does not create a Malay common-noun meaning. See [Rowling's account](https://www.harrypotter.com/writing-by-jk-rowling/dolores-umbridge).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Umbridge 与英语 take umbrage“动辄觉得受冒犯”联系起来，记住这个容不得挑战的角色；不要拆成 um + bridge。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish two entries spelled ungkap: one concerns opening the mouth to breathe, while the other concerns expression. Ungkapkan belongs to the second family, alongside ungkapan and pengungkapan. Their shared spelling can suggest a memorable image of giving thoughts an outlet, but that image is a learning device, not proof of a common historical origin.

etymology.historical_story: One documented origin of Unger is a German designation for a Hungarian, also used of someone with trading connections to Hungary. Such descriptions could become hereditary surnames and occur among German and Ashkenazic Jewish families. This history explains a naming pattern; it does not identify the nationality, religion, or ancestry of an unspecified modern bearer. etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowing story. Urus provides the base for urusan, referring to matters requiring attention or management. Adding -nya links those matters to someone or something already mentioned. The same compact ending lets administrative prose track an applicant, a company, or an institution without repeating its name. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=urusan).

etymology.historical_story: Umur is an Arabic loan associated with the duration of life. Its Jawi spelling preserves the Arabic initial letter ‘ayn, while adding a vowel letter in the second syllable. Malay combines this established noun with -ku, the shortened form of aku. The resulting umurku means “my age” or, in reflective contexts, “my life.” [DBP：Jawi 借词说明](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2023/05/DEWAN-BAHASA-JUN-2023-qo0gqy.pdf), [DBP：-ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=serangkai)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 u-mur-ku 分成 umur（年龄）和 ku（我的）：在生日蛋糕上写下“我的年龄”。
