etymology.historical_story: Ulang means repeat or return, while tahun means year. Together they picture an important date returning as the calendar completes another cycle. Malay uses the expression for personal birthdays and public anniversaries alike. Although the joined spelling appears in informal writing and older records, contemporary Malaysian standard spelling keeps the two components separate.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ulang‘再来一次’＋tahun‘一年’：日历转一圈，同一个纪念日又回来。记住写成两个词：ulang tahun。

senses.nuances: 化学领域的物质名词，通常不按普通可数名词使用。uranium 指元素本身，不等于“核武器”。科学资料见 [Royal Society of Chemistry](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/92/Uranium)。

etymology.historical_story: Uranium takes its name from the planet Uranus. Martin Heinrich Klaproth identified the new element in pitchblende in 1789, although the material he obtained was an oxide. Eugène-Melchior Péligot isolated the metal in 1841. Malay uses the international scientific name, preserving a connection between astronomical naming and the history of chemistry.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: uranium → U → 铀；再把开头 uran- 连到 Uranus（天王星），一起记住元素名的来历。

etymology.historical_story: Udara belongs to the old Indic borrowing layer shared by Malay and Indonesian. The World Loanword Database links Indonesian udara to Sanskrit udāra, associated with height and rising mist or vapour. The form udaranya adds Malay -nya, allowing an inherited borrowing to refer naturally to the air of a particular place. [Source: WOLD](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839604681227).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先读 udara＝空气，再接 nya＝其：udaranya segar，就是那里的空气很清新。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是 kamu 的附着式代词，在此表示领属；严格说是后附着语素，而非派生后缀。连写时词根不发生音变，读音可分为 u.mur.mu。资料包所给 Jawi عمور 仅对应词根 umur，未包含 -mu；此处依要求保留原字段。

senses.zh_definition: 你的年龄；你从出生至所指时间已经生活的年数或时长。

senses.nuances: 由 umur 的年龄义加领属附着语素 -mu 组成，并非新的独立词根。口语也常说 umur awak 或 umur kau；umurmu 常带亲近、书面或抒情色彩。释义据词根义和代词规则合成：[DBP：umur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=umur)、[DBP：-mu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mu)。

etymology.historical_story: Umur comes from Arabic ʿumr, meaning life, lifetime, or age. It became an ordinary Malay word used for people and things. The ending -mu belongs to Malay grammar and represents kamu. Thus umurmu combines an Arabic-derived noun with a Malay possessive clitic, illustrating how borrowed vocabulary becomes part of everyday local expression. [WOLD](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839307846234).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: umur＝年龄，-mu＝你的：umurmu＝你的年龄。把它与 umurku＝我的年龄成对记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此是表示第三人称所属的附着代词，按给定分类归入 suffix；词根不变，ny 读 /ɲ/。输入 Jawi اوسها 实为 usaha 的拼写，完整 usahanya 应写作 اوسهاڽ；音节可分析为 u.sa.ha.nya，但 syllables 保留输入的 null。

etymology.historical_story: Usahanya is a grammatical extension of usaha, rather than a separate historical borrowing. Malay attaches -nya directly to a noun to identify a previously mentioned possessor. This lets a report introduce a person by name and then refer economically to that person's efforts. The same pattern appears in rumahnya and bukunya, making this entry part of a productive everyday system.

etymology.historical_story: Ulangan illustrates Malay word formation: ulang supplies the idea of doing something again, while -an names a related event or result. Its dictionary meanings connect recurring sounds, return visits, and repeated broadcasts. A regional distinction matters in classrooms: Indonesian ulangan can mean an ordinary test, whereas Malaysian examination contexts also use ulangan for resits. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=ulangan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 ulang＝再来一次；加 -an，把“再来”变成“重复的那一项”。看到 siaran ulangan，就想到节目又播一遍。

etymology.historical_story: Ukiah's name preserves an Indigenous Californian connection rather than a Malay root. The city's historical account traces it to the Yokaia people, whose name means people of the south valley. Its passage into English spelling reflects how local names were recorded by outsiders. Learning it as a place name preserves that cultural connection. See [City of Ukiah](https://cityofukiah.com/150history/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按英语读成近似 you-KAI-uh，联想地图上的加州城市 Ukiah；这是地名记忆，不是马来语词根分析。

headword.linguistic_status: 资料包不足以确定该词的原始语境。以下条件性解释限于英语 unc 在马来语混合交流中的使用，未确认其为规范马来语词条。status 为请求指定的条目标签。

senses.nuances: 年龄判断是相对的，并无固定年龄门槛。此处解释英语俚语的混用，不宣称它是通用马来语称谓。以下为教学搭配示例。英语词典标示该义有时具冒犯性，参见 [Cambridge：unc](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/unc)。

etymology.historical_story: English unc is a shortened form of uncle. Its uses range from a familiar family reference to a teasing label for an older man, with tone determining whether it feels affectionate or insulting. These English meanings explain possible code-switching, but the isolated packet does not establish which meaning its original occurrence had. See [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/unc).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: uncle 截短成 unc：先想到“叔叔”，再根据语气判断是在亲昵称呼，还是调侃“大叔感”。这个记法不适用于另有全称的 UNC 缩写。

morphology.pattern_note: 外来词整词作为独立词素记忆，不能把 us- 或 -kup 当作马来语词缀。keuskupan 由 ke-...-an 构成；uskup agung 是复合称谓。

senses.nuances: 在天主教语境中常见，也可用于采用主教制度的其他基督宗派。不是所有 paderi 都是 uskup；uskup agung 指总主教，不能直接等同教宗。相关词形与用法参见 [Malay uskup](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/uskup#Malay)。

etymology.historical_story: Uskup is traced through Arabic usquf to the older Christian vocabulary represented by Greek episkopos, meaning an overseer, with Syriac in the transmission history. It illustrates how an Arabic loan in Malay can name a Christian office. Once established, the word also supported Malay morphology: keuskupan names the bishop's ecclesiastical territory. See [the documented etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/uskup#Malay).

etymology.historical_story: Ucapan belongs to the family built around ucap, referring to spoken expression. The ending -an forms a noun, while -nya links that expression to someone already identifiable in context. A familiar cultural setting is the ceremonial address: listeners may discuss both the speaker's message and the wishes offered. The word therefore connects everyday remarks with public acts of appreciation.

etymology.historical_story: Untu is documented as the word for tooth in a government-published dictionary of Tegal Javanese. Such regional vocabulary can appear inside Malay discussions when speakers compare languages or quote family speech. Its appearance in a Malay corpus therefore need not indicate borrowing into standard Malay. The dictionary establishes its Javanese meaning, but does not by itself establish its earliest historical origin.

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -kan 构成及物动词词干；utamakan 常用于祈使句，对应完整主动形式 mengutamakan。接后缀后原词末尾 a 通常保留 [a]。数据包中的 اوتام 是词根 utama 的拼写；本条补全派生形式为 اوتاماکن。

senses.zh_definition: 把某人或某事放在优先地位；先考虑或处理。
senses.en_definition: Give someone or something priority; put first.
senses.ms_definition: Berikan keutamaan kepada seseorang atau sesuatu dengan mendahulukannya daripada yang lain.
senses.nuances: 常用于告示、提醒、口号及指示，如 Utamakan keselamatan。通常带宾语；正式陈述句一般使用 mengutamakan，如 Syarikat mengutamakan keselamatan。此释义按 DBP 对 mengutamakan 的解释整理。[DBP：utama](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=utama)。

senses.zh_definition: 着重考虑或关注某一对象；把它作为主要关切，有时含偏重之意。

senses.ms_definition: Tumpukan perhatian atau kepentingan kepada seseorang atau sesuatu sebagai perkara yang utama.
senses.nuances: 与“先后次序”的义项不同，此处重点是关注或看重什么。搭配 diri sendiri 可表达自我照顾，也可在批评语境中指只顾自己，须结合上下文理解。[DBP：mengutamakan 的义项](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=utama)。

etymology.historical_story: Utama comes from Sanskrit uttama, meaning highest, best or foremost. Malay retained this sense of prominence and developed everyday grammatical relatives around it. Adding -kan produces utamakan, familiar in instructions that place safety, health or shared interests first. The older idea of being foremost thus becomes a practical instruction about priorities. [Research on utama](https://psasir.upm.edu.my/id/eprint/116202/1/116201.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: utama＝首要；加 -kan，就把“首要”变成行动：utamakan＝把它放第一。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary label Mn places this word in Minangkabau usage. Its value lies in everyday relationships: an elder sister can be addressed through a kinship term rather than only by her personal name. Related social address practices can extend that respect beyond immediate family. The supplied evidence does not establish a deeper historical derivation.

senses.en_definition: To bring up past matters again, especially grievances, mistakes, or favours previously given.
senses.ms_definition: Membangkitkan semula perkara yang telah lalu, khususnya perkara yang menimbulkan rasa tidak senang.
senses.nuances: 常带责备、计较或翻旧账的意味，并非中性的“提及”。正式主动句通常用 mengungkit；祈使句可用 Jangan ungkit perkara lama。释义依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=ungkit)。

collocations.zh: 拿自己过去的恩惠说事
collocations.en: to keep reminding someone of past favours

senses.zh_definition: 用杠杆、棍棒等工具的一端将物体撬起或撬开。
senses.en_definition: To lift or pry something up using a lever or similar tool.
senses.ms_definition: Mengangkat atau membuka sesuatu dengan menggunakan hujung tuas atau alat seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: 指利用工具施力的撬动，不是泛指徒手拿起。完整主动形式为 mengungkit；ungkit 可用于操作指令。

senses.zh_definition: 上下摆动或翘动；主要见于 ungkit-ungkit、ungkang-ungkit 等固定重叠形式。
senses.en_definition: To move up and down or seesaw, chiefly in established reduplicated forms.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak turun naik atau berjungkat-jungkit, terutama dalam bentuk ungkit-ungkit atau ungkang-ungkit.
senses.nuances: 此义属于特定重叠构式，不宜直接套用于所有单独出现的 ungkit。以下列出词典记录的构式，不将其频率等同于“翻旧账”义。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengerusi mengingatkan ahli mesyuarat, 'Jangan ungkit pertikaian lama yang telah diselesaikan.'
dual_scenarios.zh: 主席提醒与会者：“不要重提已经解决的旧争端。”
dual_scenarios.en: The chair reminded participants, 'Do not reopen old disputes that have already been resolved.'

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jangan ungkit hal tu lagi lah, aku dah minta maaf.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jangan ungkit perkara itu lagi; saya sudah meminta maaf.
dual_scenarios.zh: 别再翻那件事的旧账啦，我都道过歉了。
dual_scenarios.en: Stop bringing that up. I've already apologised.
spoken_features: tu 对应 itu
dah 对应 sudah
lah 表达劝止及不耐烦，语气随语调变化
口语 minta maaf 对应完整形式 meminta maaf

messages.ms_spoken: Jangan ungkit hal tu lagi lah, aku dah minta maaf.
messages.ms_standard: Jangan ungkit perkara itu lagi; saya sudah meminta maaf.
messages.zh: 别再翻那件事的旧账啦，我都道过歉了。
messages.en: Stop bringing that up. I've already apologised.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey, aku tak ungkit dah. Kita bincang yang sekarang je.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, saya tidak akan mengungkitnya lagi. Kita bincangkan perkara semasa sahaja.
messages.zh: 好，我不再提了。我们就谈眼前的事吧。
messages.en: Okay, I won't bring it up again. Let's focus on what's happening now.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Jangan ungkit 容易显得指责或不耐烦。需要缓和时可说 Saya harap kita tidak mengungkit perkara itu lagi。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 提起自己曾给对方的帮助可能让人觉得在讨人情。工作复盘若只想中性回顾，可用 membincangkan semula，避免无意指控对方翻旧账。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 提起自己曾给对方的帮助可能让人觉得在讨人情。工作复盘若只想中性回顾，可用 membincangkan semula，避免无意指控对方翻旧账。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record both the physical action of levering something up and the figurative action of bringing old matters back into conversation. The shared image offers a useful teaching connection: a buried grievance is lifted into view like a stubborn lid. This is a semantic comparison, not proof of which meaning arose first.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ungkit：把盖子“撬起来”，也把旧账“撬出来”；两种意义都抓住“重新抬起”。
